meta.name: consciousness-council
meta.description: Structures a multi-perspective council exercise for decisions, research trade-offs, and creative challenges. Simulates thinking archetypes, separates evidence from assumptions and values, and synthesizes a conditional recommendation. Use when the user requests a council, panel, devil's advocate analysis, "mind council", or deliberate comparison of perspectives on a difficult choice.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把你的难题交给多个思维视角分别发言,权衡后给出一份有条件的建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对难以取舍的选择,想先听听不同角度的看法
copy.tagline_en: Run a panel of viewpoints on a hard decision and get a weighed recommendation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you face a hard choice and want different angles weighed first

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会对你的问题开一场「意识委员会」:先挑 4~6 个思维原型,各自给出立场、理由、看到的风险和意外洞见,再综合出共识点、核心张力、无人提及的盲点、建议路径与置信度。
howto.when: 当你面对难做决定的取舍、困境或创意挑战,或提到「council mode」「mind council」、要求委员会/小组讨论、唱反调分析时触发。

say.text: 用委员会模式帮我决定要不要换工作
say.note: 会选 4~6 个思维原型并给出综合建议

say.text: 快速委员会:该先做 A 功能还是 B 功能
say.note: 只用 3 位成员,回复更短

say.text: 加上未来学家,去掉极简主义者
say.note: 调整参与委员会的成员

howto.what_en: Claude runs a Mind Council: it picks 4-6 thinking archetypes for your question, each giving a position, reasoning, key risk and insight, then synthesizes convergence, core tension, blind spot, a recommended path and confidence level.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you face a hard decision, trade-off or creative challenge, ask for a council/panel/board or devil's advocate analysis, or say "council mode" or "mind council".

say_en.text: Run council mode on whether I should change jobs.
say_en.note: Picks 4-6 archetypes and synthesizes a recommendation

say_en.text: Quick council: should we build feature A or B first?
Add the Futurist and drop the Minimalist.
say_en.note: Changes which archetypes sit on the council
